title: GDPD5-CD55-EGFR competitive binding axis regulates radioresistance and lipid accumulation in rectal cancer.
authors: Zhu, Ruiqiu; Li, Mingyue; Shen, Yi; Zou, Li; Jin, Limin; Shen, Yuntian; Zhu, Yaqun; Peng, Qiliang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究直肠癌放疗耐药中GDPD5-CD55-EGFR竞争性结合调控脂质积累，虽涉及分子对接和蛋白互作，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Resistance to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in rectal cancer diminishes survival benefits, potentially due to dysregulated lipid metabolism, though the mechanisms are unclear. Using the MSigDB database and GSE68204 cohort, we identified lipid metabolism genes linked to radiotherapy resistance. We developed resistant cell lines and xenograft models, and through multi-algorithm analysis (SVM-RFE, RF, LASSO), pinpointed key genes. Molecular mechanisms were explored via Western blotting, co-immunoprecipitation, molecular docking, and functional assays, validated in patient-derived organoids. Our study found that radiotherapy-resistant rectal cancer shows a lipid accumulation phenotype, with an inverse relationship between lipid droplet deposition and radiosensitivity in resistant cell models. The multi-algorithm screening identified GDPD5 as a key regulator. Silencing GDPD5 reduced lipid accumulation and increased radiosensitivity. Mechanistically, GDPD5 competes with CD55, disrupting its interaction with EGFR and promoting EGFR nuclear translocation, which suppresses p53 and leads to lipid buildup and radiotherapy resistance in tumors. Clinical samples showed high GDPD5 and low CD55 levels correlate with EGFR nuclear localization. Patient-derived organoids with high GDPD5 also showed increased radiotherapy resistance. Our findings indicate that GDPD5 facilitates EGFR nuclear translocation by binding to CD55, suppressing p53, and causing lipid accumulation and radiotherapy resistance in tumors. Targeting the GDPD5-CD55-EGFR interaction may enhance radiosensitivity.
abstract_zh: 直肠癌对新辅助放化疗的耐药性降低了生存获益，可能源于脂质代谢失调，但其机制尚不清楚。利用MSigDB数据库和GSE68204队列，我们鉴定了与放疗耐药相关的脂质代谢基因。我们建立了耐药细胞系和异种移植模型，并通过多算法分析（SVM-RFE、RF、LASSO）确定了关键基因。通过Western blotting、共免疫沉淀、分子对接和功能实验探讨了分子机制，并在患者来源的类器官中进行了验证。我们的研究发现，放疗耐药的直肠癌表现出脂质积累表型，耐药细胞模型中脂滴沉积与放射敏感性呈负相关。多算法筛选确定GDPD5为关键调控因子。沉默GDPD5减少了脂质积累并增加了放射敏感性。机制上，GDPD5与CD55竞争，破坏其与EGFR的相互作用，促进EGFR核转位，从而抑制p53，导致肿瘤中脂质积累和放疗耐药。临床样本显示，高GDPD5和低CD55水平与EGFR核定位相关。高GDPD5的患者来源类器官也表现出增加的放疗耐药性。我们的研究结果表明，GDPD5通过与CD55结合促进EGFR核转位，抑制p53，并导致肿瘤中脂质积累和放疗耐药。靶向GDPD5-CD55-EGFR相互作用可能增强放射敏感性。
